title: These GitHub Projects Are Trending Right Now 🤯💻
description:
I discovered GitHub Trending, a simple way to discover repositories that are gaining attention from the developer community.

You can find everything from AI agent projects and coding tools to open-source experiments and developer utilities.

And the best part? You can switch between today, this week, and this month to see what's gaining traction over different time periods.

If you're always looking for the next cool AI or developer tool, this is definitely one to bookmark.
